key_idea: Subtract i from t_i; the target becomes a constant sequence, and the best constant for a sum of absolute deviations is the median.
sketch: Let a_i = t_i - i. The final tuning is c+i for some c, so the cost is sum |a_i - c|, minimised at the median of a (found with nth_element). O(n). The answer can reach about 1e5 * 5e5, so use 64-bit integers; the optimal c is always an integer because a median element works.
